dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave curvature on the trailing edge, forming a deep falcate arc from the apex to the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius resulting in a sub-acute, slightly rounded highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: High angular steepness, measured at approximately 55 degrees relative to the longitudinal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Tall vertical profile with a high aspect ratio, where height exceeds the longitudinal base width by approximately 1.2:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large, consistent radius forming a blunt, bulbous, and nearly vertical anterior surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear depigmented scars (rake marks) distributed across the dorsal and lateral torso; distinct circular light-colored lesion or mark on the mid-trailing edge of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Square-shaped cranial profile with a notable lack of a defined rostral protrusion.
